title: RustChap puzzle
description: One puzzle: goal, code template with ⟦slot⟧ markers, constrained interaction, evaluation spec, and mechanical scoring. The canonical Rust implementation (parsing, validation, reconstruction) lives in crates/puzzle-schema.

version.description: Puzzle revision, independent of schema_version. Bump on any change that affects answers or scores.

goal.description: The one-line objective shown on the puzzle screen.

template.description: Rust source with ⟦slot_id⟧ markers (U+27E6/U+27E7 — never legal Rust). Required for slot-selection and minimal-edit; absent for block-arrangement and best-solution. A slot id may appear at multiple positions; all get the same value.

explanation.description: Shown after solving (swipe left). Why the optimal answer is optimal.

prerequisites.description: Puzzle ids that must be solved first. Existence is checked at pack level by the linter.

slotInteraction.description: One engine path, two presentations: slot-selection may start blank (original: null); minimal-edit pre-fills every slot with its original and scores token_edits — each slot's original MUST then appear among its choices so 'keep' is expressible.

original.description: The token as originally written (minimal-edit), or null for a blank slot (slot-selection).

label.description: Optional short label for the choice tray, e.g. 'argument'.

blockArrangement.description: User orders ALL blocks; source = fixed_prefix + blocks-in-order + fixed_suffix. No template field.

code.description: A complete compiling program; correctness of the *choice* is judged by metrics under the stated goal.

tests.description: Rust #[test] functions appended in a test module to the reconstructed source.

clippy.description: Clippy lints that must produce no hits for the answer to rank above Solved (they feed clippy_warning_count).

metric.description: All mechanically computable. token_edits: slots whose submitted choice differs from original (slot interactions only). clone_count: syntactic .clone()/.to_owned() in user-controlled text. Allocation-style qualities ride on specific Clippy lints.

scoring.description: Ranks are mechanical: Solved = compiles + tests pass. Fluent = Solved + every fluent threshold met (metric <= value). Optimal = Solved + every optimal threshold met. All metrics referenced here must be listed in evaluation.metrics.

license.description: Upstream licence (e.g. 'MIT'); null only when origin is 'original'.
